scope: actual preparation and live-probe failures retained for review; synthetic prompts only

failures.observed: browser-harness 0.1.13 requires Pillow 12.3.0; upstream pins Pillow 13.0.0
failures.resolution: Source review found upstream tool.uv overrides. Full resolution succeeded with those overrides and the upstream three-day quarantine. The earlier raw check does not prove a full-stack blocker. A separate lean inference profile avoids loading unused engines; no Pillow downgrade.

failures.observed: libgomp.so.1 absent from minimal base image
failures.resolution: Added only libgomp1 through signed Ubuntu repositories; recorded version and built image ID.

failures.observed: Actual Hermes guard rejected the configured 8192-token window; requires at least 64000
failures.resolution: Selected a native-262144-context Qwen3.5 model and configured a 65536-token server; no guard disabled.

failures.prompt: What is 18 plus 13? Reply with only the integer.
failures.resolution: A later bounded-reasoning run still failed another case (11 plus 15 returned 16, expected 26). The 0.8B candidate is rejected for this acceptance gate; evaluate the 2B model against unchanged regression/random-arithmetic/uppercase checks.

limitations: Small-model competence is not established by successful imports, API calls or a few prompt checks. Historical failures are not erased by a later passing probe.
